name: no-ai-slop
description: Removes 20+ patterns of AI slop from any piece of writing.
readmeExcerpt:
# No AI Slop

Remove 20+ patterns of AI slop from your writing without flattening your personal voice.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f3055450-78eb-4672-880a-88a4fa54bde9

## Problem

AI makes it easy to generate clean writing that all sounds the same. Even the best models keep producing lines like:

- “It’s not X. It’s Y.”
- “What nobody tells you is…”
- “The future isn’t coming. It’s already here.”

When you use AI to edit, it can also smooth away the vocabulary, cadence, humor, and imperfections that make the writing sound like you.

## How to install No AI Slop

The easiest way to install the skill is to paste this into ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, or your favorite coding agent:

```text
Install the /no-ai-slop skill globally from https://github.com/petergyang/no-ai-slop
```

You can also install it with `npx`:

```sh
npx skills add petergyang/no-ai-slop --skill no-ai-slop --global --yes
```

## How to use No AI Slop

### Edit your writing

```text
/no-ai-slop (your writing)
```

The skill removes the AI slop patterns, preserves your personal voice, and lists what it changed.

### Detect slop

```text
/no-ai-slop is this slop? (your writing)
```

The skill quotes every slop pattern it found without guessing whether AI wrote the text.

### Generate slop for fun

```text
Draft an AI slop post about (topic)
```

Use it to generate the most cringe AI slop possible as satire.

## The slop that this skill catches

No AI Slop checks for 20+ patterns, including:

1. **Binary contrasts.** “It’s not X. It’s Y.”
2. **Throat-clearing openers.** “Here’s the thing,” “Let me be clear”
3. **Faux-insight setups.** “What nobody tells you,” “The part everyone misses”
4. **Colon reveals.** “The best part: it learns.”
5. **Dramatic fragments.** “That’s it. That’s the whole thing.”
6. **Superficial analysis.** “highlighting the team’s commitment to innovation”
7. **Importance puffery.** “marks a pivotal moment,” “a testament to”
8. **Weasel attribution.** “experts agree,” “studies show”
9. **Synonym cycling.** “The agent handles your email. The assistant drafts replies.”
10. **Fake-profound endings.** “The future isn’t coming. It’s already here.”

It also checks the fundamentals: Lead with the point when that helps, use active voice, untangle hard-to-follow sentences, and prefer concrete details over abstractions.

## What’s inside

- [`SKILL.md`](skills/no-ai-slop/SKILL.md) contains the editing rules and workflow.
- [`eval.md`](skills/no-ai-slop/eval.md) contains the checks the skill runs on its work.
- [`.codex-plugin/plugin.json`](.codex-plugin/plugin.json) contains the ChatGPT and Codex plugin metadata.
- [`build_plugin.py`](scripts/build_plugin.py) builds and validates the plugin package.

No AI Slop is also available as a plugin in ChatGPT.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A specialized skill to detect and remove generic AI writing patterns while preserving the author's personal voice.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: No AI Slop is an editing tool designed to identify and eliminate repetitive, generic phrases commonly generated by AI models. It actively scans text for over 20 specific patterns of 'AI slop', such as binary contrasts and superficial analysis markers. The tool edits the provided text to remove these clichés without flattening the writer's original vocabulary, cadence, or humor. It functions as an installable skill that can be loaded into coding agents like Claude Code and Codex or run via npx. By automating the editing process, it helps writers produce cleaner, more authentic content.
keyFeatures: Pattern detection: Identifies over 20 distinct patterns of generic AI writing, including throat-clearing openers and weasel words.
Voice preservation: Edits text carefully to remove clichés while retaining the author's unique tone and imperfections.
Global installation: Can be installed globally using npx to make the command available across different environments.
Agent integration: Easily loads into popular AI coding assistants like ChatGPT and Claude Code as a dedicated skill.
Detection mode: Offers a specific command to quote found slop patterns without altering the original text.

useCases.title: Editing AI generated drafts
useCases.description: Clean up first drafts generated by language models by removing their tell-tale generic phrasing.

useCases.title: Reviewing professional communications
useCases.description: Ensure emails, blog posts, and internal memos sound authentic and avoid superficial corporate jargon.

useCases.title: Generating satirical content
useCases.description: Use the reverse functionality to intentionally generate highly clichéd AI slop for satirical purposes.

useCases.title: Auditing writing quality
useCases.description: Run the detection command on existing documentation to highlight areas that read too much like machine-generated text.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This tool is intended for writers, editors, and developers who frequently use AI to assist with drafting but want to maintain a human voice. It is highly beneficial for anyone looking to quickly clean up text without performing tedious manual edits.
